name: Eigenvalue-Driven Texture Parameterization for LIC
aliases: Metric-based Texture Parameter Mapping for Tensor Field Visualization
Physical tensor visualization via metric distortion
Tensor field LIC with eigenvalue scaling
definition: A method to visualize symmetric second-order tensor fields by mapping eigenvalues to texture parameters (density, spot size, convolution length, color intensity) to visually represent compression and expansion, treating the tensor as a distortion of a flat metric.
summary: This method visualizes tensor fields by mapping eigenvalues to Line Integral Convolution parameters, varying density and spot size to encode physical compression and expansion unlike standard constant-parameter LIC.
